name: BreckenWander
description: BreckenWander is an independent travel platform built around all-in pricing: the first price you see includes every mandatory tax and fee. This connector lets Claude search flights, hotels, and experiences for your dates and party — returning BreckenWander's all-in price plus a direct link to complete the booking on breckenwander.com. It can also combine chosen flights, a hotel, and experiences into one trip link that opens the whole itinerary pre-loaded for a single checkout. It is read-only — Claude never books or takes payment, and prices are non-binding until checkout. Founded and operated by Elton Johnson, a retired U.S. Army officer and 20-year attorney, in Elizabethtown, Kentucky. BreckenWander is the Merchant of Record on completed bookings.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BreckenWander to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BreckenWander to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.breckenwander.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is BreckenWander MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, BreckenWander scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BreckenWander MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BreckenWander provides these MCP tools: build_trip, search_experiences, search_flights, and search_hotels.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BreckenWander?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BreckenWander in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
BreckenWander does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
BreckenWander is developed by Elton Johnson. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
